description:
Shruwd is an AI search visibility tool. When a buyer asks an AI assistant for the best tool in your category, a few names come back. Shruwd shows where your brand stands in those answers, works out why they leave you out, and tells you which page to change. Then it checks whether the change worked.

It asks the questions your buyers ask and records how often the answers name you and cite your pages, which competitors show up, and which of the companies you track gets named first.

To find the cause, Shruwd reads your site's logs to see which AI crawlers visit, what they fetch and which requests fail. Visits are checked against the IP ranges or DNS names each crawler's owner publishes, so a faked user agent doesn't count. It also looks at the pages the answers cite in your place. Each finding names the cause and the change to make, usually on a specific page, and says how sure Shruwd is.

You make the change. Shruwd then asks the same questions the same way and says a fix worked only when the movement clears a statistical bar and is big enough to matter.

Rates from AI answers come with their ranges, since each answer is one sample of what a buyer might see. Crawler numbers are counts from your logs, so they're exact. Shruwd doesn't roll any of them into a single visibility score.

From ChatGPT you can:
- See how often AI answers name your brand and each of your competitors, now and over time
- Go through the latest answers one by one: whether each named you or a competitor, and which pages it cited
- See what's holding your brand back, with the recommended fix for each finding
- Mark a fix as applied, so Shruwd checks again
- Set up a brand: add prompts and competitors, or have Shruwd suggest them from your homepage
- Check which AI crawlers reach your site, once your logs are connected

It's built for founders and small marketing teams without an SEO department. To connect, sign in with your Shruwd account and choose read-only or read-and-write access. Setting up a brand or marking a fix needs read-and-write. Results from a new measurement arrive over the following hours.

defaultPrompt: How visible is my brand in AI search compared to my competitors?
What's holding my brand back in AI answers, and what should I fix first?
Set up tracking for my website and suggest the prompts and competitors to track.
